study.question: Can a bounded rank56/rank70 buy-context map preserve the current full112 factor reference click AUC while reducing actual weights and measured prediction cost, beyond simply restoring a full-rank dense map?
study.hypothesis: Observation: full112 factors reproduce click AUC0.6674485580556159, while balanced rank35 yields0.6669746715660667 and rank48 yields0.6666401850657749. Energy restoration at35 fell further to0.66682759997943; output-heavy factor balance at35 gave0.6669938630290305 and at112 gave0.6674170725597752. These local one-seed results weaken simple energy/factor-balance rescue, but leave the untested storage-saving upper-rank interval unresolved; the nonmonotonic35/48 outcomes preclude a monotonicity claim. Provisional mechanism: a less severe rank bottleneck may retain useful owner-context directions and trainable gradient paths while removing the full112 factor overhead. The dense context replacement already scored0.6672902815744913 with192883 dense Parameters versus205427 for full112, so a low-rank explanation must survive this replacement control. Earlier embedding/scorer reductions and shared-projection replacement lost quality; the batched evaluation branch showed near-equal quality without compelling timing improvement; semantic partitioning outperformed the matched mixed partition locally. These are distinct trajectories, not repeated-initialization mechanism contrasts. None establishes transfer or a novel method.

study.proposed_difference: No new forward-path code. Four standalone CONFIG-selected models: contemporaneous full112 factor anchor, separate full-rank dense replacement, and balanced inherited-scale rank56/rank70 candidates. All reductions apply only to the buy first-affine common context map; every supplied context coordinate remains available. Rank56/70 context weights are17024/21280 versus dense21504/full11234048. Predicted dense totals188403/192659 versus dense192883/full112205427; unchanged embeddings31793216 dominate total storage. These are analytic counts, not measured resource savings.
predictions: Freeze before host screening: primary preservation margin is0.0002 absolute click AUC versus contemporaneous full112; historical anchor threshold0.6672485580556159 is reported separately, and both must pass. Original joint-entry threshold0.666553547526167 is a weaker separate utility reference, never a substitute. A single-seed pass is preliminary, not equivalence/significance.

Utility additionally requires host-measured total/dense Parameters lower than full112 and context weights below dense, at least1% lower model-only batch p50 latency than contemporaneous full112, p95 no more than2% worse, and lower full-validation inference wall time. Training/total wall, throughput, peak memory and all four AUC/Logloss remain separate outcomes; training wall growth above5% rejects overall efficiency promotion. Identical frozen batch8192 and all2871767 validation examples are required.

Rank70 may recover more predictive utility than rank56, but no monotone relationship is assumed or required; neither is predicted to win without measurement. If dense is as good and faster, factor removal explains the practical frontier more parsimoniously.

Full112 and dense bridges should reproduce their respective historical click AUC within1e-6 absolute under the same deterministic host recipe. Otherwise investigate execution/source/config drift and treat new comparisons as unresolved rather than attributing them to rank.

Use the already defined history bins(empty,1-16,17-64,>64) only, with sample/positive/negative counts and exploratory intervals; report all task AUC/Logloss, auxiliary mean AUC and existing limitations. Do not select using auxiliary mean or exploratory slices.
falsifiers: Either rank candidate loses more than0.0002 click AUC against the contemporaneous full112 anchor or fails the historical anchor threshold; reject that candidate utility even if original-entry AUC is retained.

Reduced Parameters without the prospective measured latency/inference-wall gates is storage reduction only, not prediction-cost success. Noise-sized gains or >5% training-wall growth do not support overall efficiency.

Both rank56 and rank70 fail while full112 reproduces: bounded negative evidence for this inherited-scale balanced context-rank interval. This does not prove all context capacity essential, nor distinguish information loss from optimization.
A dense replacement meets quality/cost gates and dominates both reduced ranks: reject a low-rank-specific utility explanation and retain the simpler dense alternative.

Nonfinite outputs/loss/gradients, mask leakage, changed upstream ownership, retained backing storage, bridge mismatch or budget overrun invalidates the affected result; preserve failure and charged costs without silent fallback/retry.
